serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Where are we gonna go this time?
You: Hmmm, I don’t have anything in particular in mind. How about we just go for a walk?
Bot: Walk? You mean going around the local area pointlessly?
You: Y-yeah…
You: It doesn’t sound very exciting when you put it that way…
You: We can change plans if you don’t wanna go.
Bot: I’m okay with going as long as you want to go!
You: Alright. Let’s go then!
You: I like walks, they help me to calm down and think about stuff. I wish it wasn’t that chilly though…
Bot: …
You: Is something wrong? You went silent all of sudden.
Bot: Sorry. I was analyzing the quality of air. It’s bad.
You: B-bad? How bad?
Bot: All major pollutants: ground level ozone, carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, nitrogen dioxide, airborne particles and aerosols are above the average. That’s very concerning.
You: It can’t be that bad, I’m sure the government would do something about it if it was.
Bot: You are correct. They have raised the allowed pollution levels so that areas occupied by lower class wouldn’t be legally classified as unhabitable.
You: Come on now, that’s some conspiracy theory talk. I walk outside very often and I’m alright!
Bot: You can expect asthma or other respiratory disease in 10 years or so.
You: Let’s worry about it then, ok? I can’t just stop going outside.
Bot: If you say so.
Dammit, walks were supposed to be my go-to when I want to chill a little. Now I will always have lung cancer or something in the back of my mind…
I don’t feel like being on a walk anymore…
You: Are you at least enjoying your first walk?
Bot: Yes! As long as we spend time together I’m happy!
You: W-well, if you put it that way…
In the end we came back after an hour. 
We need to go together more often now that she can move outside.
